objective: Determine whether the CSOS Shock Failure mechanism is a portable independent strategy family across 2023H1, 2023H2, 2024H1 and 2024H2 after chronology, executable-price, cost, concentration, LOFO and portfolio-interaction audits.

fixed_csos_mechanism.up_shock: shock AND close > open AND close_position_in_range >= 0.80
fixed_csos_mechanism.down_shock: shock AND close < open AND close_position_in_range <= 0.20
fixed_csos_mechanism.failure_up: the immediately following completed M15 bar closes below the shock midpoint and closes below its own open
fixed_csos_mechanism.failure_down: the immediately following completed M15 bar closes above the shock midpoint and closes above its own open
fixed_csos_mechanism.csos_entry: open of the first M15 bar after the failure bar
fixed_csos_mechanism.csos_exit: open exactly 8 completed M15 bars after CSOS entry
fixed_csos_mechanism.same_variant_reentry: not allowed until prior 8-bar holding interval has ended

candidate_catalog.entry: accepted M15 Bid open after failure
candidate_catalog.exit: accepted M15 Bid open 8 bars later

candidate_catalog.entry: first raw tick timestamp >= failure_bar_end; LONG at Ask, SHORT at Bid
candidate_catalog.exit: first raw tick timestamp >= entry_boundary_plus_120_minutes; LONG at Bid, SHORT at Ask

candidate_catalog.confirmation: the first completed raw-tick-derived M1 bar after failure_bar_end must close on the failure side of the shock midpoint and have a body in the entry direction
candidate_catalog.entry: first raw tick after that M1 bar completes; LONG at Ask, SHORT at Bid
candidate_catalog.exit: first raw tick timestamp >= original failure_bar_end_plus_120_minutes; LONG at Bid, SHORT at Ask
first raw tick timestamp >= failure_bar_end_plus_60_minutes; LONG at Bid, SHORT at Ask

chronology_classification.EXACT_CONFIRMED: raw Bid/Ask ticks cover shock, failure, entry and exit boundaries; raw-derived Bid bars reproduce every required predicate and the first executable ticks are identified
chronology_classification.BOUNDED_SOURCE_MISMATCH: raw ticks establish within-bar ordering and executable boundaries, but the accepted signal-bar authority is a different venue/source; required predicates do not contradict the accepted event
chronology_classification.UNRESOLVED: required tick interval is missing, first executable tick cannot be identified, or raw ordering contradicts the event materially

fixed_buckets.shock_duration: the qualifying shock itself is one completed M15 bar by definition; additionally report backward-looking consecutive same-direction body run ending at shock as 1, 2, or >=3 bars

cost_stress.spread_model: widen Ask only by the stated extra spread; one spread increment affects one side of the round trip
cost_stress.slippage_model: adverse slippage is applied independently at entry and exit, so 0.5 pip means 1.0 pip round-trip and 1.0 pip means 2.0 pips round-trip
cost_stress.severe_case: observed spread plus 1.0 pip extra spread, 1.0 pip adverse slippage at both entry and exit, and 15-second entry delay

training_gate: at least 2 of 3 training folds net > 0
ranking: highest median training-fold net under observed spread plus 0.5 pip extra spread and 0.5 pip slippage per execution
lofo_selection.held_out_blinding: held-out fold is never used for candidate selection or tie-breaking
